candidates.name: Acute urticaria
support_spans: Approximately 7 hours after receiving her first dose of vaccination, she developed generalized pruritus and urticaria.
Generalized urticaria
Urticarial lesions visible on right knee and popliteal fossa
candidates.why: The patient developed generalized urticaria and angioedema after vaccination.

candidates.name: Allergic reaction
support_spans: The patient had no history of urticaria, angioedema, or COVID-19 infection.

Her symptoms were not associated with recent viral illness, new medications, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, opioids, alcohol, food, or physical stimuli including pressure or temperature changes.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms are consistent with an allergic reaction to the vaccine.

candidates.name: Anaphylaxis
